means.果然: 果然 is 'sure enough, as expected': it turned out the way someone said or thought.
means.居然: 居然 is 'to my surprise': it turned out against what anyone expected.

items.zh: 天气预报说今天有雨，下午[果然]下雨了。
items.en: The forecast said rain, and sure enough it rained in the afternoon.
items.why: Just as expected: 果然.

items.zh: 他平时不怎么学习，这次[居然]考了第一。
items.en: He hardly studies, yet this time he came top, of all things.
items.why: Against all expectations: 居然.

items.zh: 大家都说这家店好吃，我去尝了尝，[果然]不错。
items.en: Everyone said this place was good; I tried it and it really was.
items.why: As people said: 果然.

items.zh: 这么简单的问题，你[居然]不知道？
items.en: You don't even know something this simple?
items.why: Surprising: 居然.

items.zh: 我猜他会迟到，他[果然]迟到了。
items.en: I guessed he'd be late, and he was.
items.why: As I guessed: 果然.

items.zh: 外面那么冷，他[居然]只穿了一件衬衫。
items.en: It's so cold out, and he's wearing just a shirt!
items.why: Not what anyone would expect: 居然.

items.zh: 医生说吃了这个药就会好，第二天[果然]好多了。
items.en: The doctor said this medicine would help, and the next day I was much better.
items.why: As the doctor said: 果然.

items.zh: 我们才认识三天，他[居然]要跟我借钱。
items.en: We've known each other three days, and he wants to borrow money from me!
items.why: Surprising: 居然.

means.反而: 反而 is 'instead, on the contrary': the result is the opposite of what you would expect.
means.而且: 而且 is 'and what's more': it adds a point in the same direction.

items.zh: 吃了药，他的病不但没好，[反而]更重了。
items.en: After the medicine he didn't get better; instead he got worse.
items.why: The opposite of what was expected: 反而.

items.zh: 这家饭店的菜很好吃，[而且]不贵。
items.en: This restaurant's food is good, and it isn't expensive either.
items.why: One more good point: 而且.

items.zh: 我想帮他，他[反而]生气了。
items.en: I wanted to help him, but instead he got angry.
items.why: Not the expected result: 反而.

items.zh: 她会唱歌，[而且]唱得非常好。
items.en: She can sing, and she sings really well.
items.why: Adding a stronger point: 而且.

items.zh: 风不但没停，[反而]越来越大了。
items.en: The wind didn't stop; on the contrary, it got stronger.
items.why: 不但没…反而…: the opposite happened.

items.zh: 这份工作很轻松，[而且]离家很近。
items.en: This job is easy, and it's close to home as well.
items.why: One more point the same way: 而且.

items.zh: 他比我小，[反而]比我懂得多。
items.en: He's younger than me, yet he knows more than I do.
items.why: Opposite to what you'd expect: 反而.

items.zh: 这本书内容丰富，[而且]写得很有意思。
items.en: This book is full of content, and it's interesting too.
items.why: Adding a point: 而且.

title: 根本, 简直 or 绝对?

means.根本: 根本 is 'at all, simply not': it is mostly used with 不 or 没 to deny something completely.
means.简直: 简直 is 'simply, practically': it exaggerates, often with 像, 太…了 or 是.
means.绝对: 绝对 is 'absolutely, definitely': a firm promise or a certain claim.

items.zh: 我[根本]不认识他。
items.en: I don't know him at all.
items.why: Not at all, with 不: 根本.

items.zh: 这里的风景[简直]太美了！
items.en: The scenery here is just too beautiful!
items.why: Exaggerating, with 太…了: 简直.

items.zh: 放心，我[绝对]不会告诉别人。
items.en: Don't worry, I definitely won't tell anyone.
items.why: A firm promise: 绝对.

items.zh: 这件事[简直]像做梦一样。
items.en: This is just like a dream.
items.why: Exaggerating, with 像: 简直.

items.zh: 他[根本]没来过这儿。
items.en: He has never been here at all.
items.why: Completely denying, with 没: 根本.

items.zh: 这个价格[绝对]是全市最低的。
items.en: This price is definitely the lowest in the city.
items.why: A certain claim: 绝对.

items.zh: 他做的菜[简直]比饭店的还好吃。
items.en: His cooking is practically better than a restaurant's.
items.why: Exaggerating: 简直.

items.zh: 这么多工作，一天[根本]做不完。
items.en: This much work simply can't be done in a day.
items.why: Completely impossible, with 不: 根本. 绝对 also works ('definitely can't').

items.zh: 这次比赛我们[绝对]能赢。
items.en: We can definitely win this match.
items.why: Certain: 绝对.
